name: Mesopotamia
overview: Scripture reveals Mesopotamia as a significant region in biblical history, associated with the patriarch Abraham's family, including Nahor's city (Genesis 24:10) and the Syrian lineage of Rebekah (Genesis 25:20). It was also the homeland of Balaam, who was hired to curse Israel (Deuteronomy 23:4). The children of Israel experienced judgment under the king of Mesopotamia, Chushanrishathaim, for eight years until God raised up Othniel as a deliverer empowered by the Spirit of the Lord (Judges 3:8-10). This demonstrates God's sovereign discipline and deliverance involving Mesopotamia in His redemptive plan.
